_doc: The one reviewed list of deliberate differences from the goldens. removed: a fact taken off a screen on purpose (cite the decision). formats: one token shown in a new format ('to' is read like page text; for ~text data, alternatives are separated by ' | '). moves: a scope renamed or moved (segment 'from' becomes 'to'). methods: hover help reworded when it moved into a disclosure. Every entry needs a reason. Read by e2e/tests/readability.spec.ts; see docs/design/READABILITY_PLAN.md.
